cache_decision.reason: The existing generic builder requires four distinct family sources and its all-output contract uses the legacy 0.8125 coefficient sum; the clean-T3 profile validator separately requires exactly three epoch-2 sources. Neither is a truthful one-parent cache contract. Direct --distill is an existing strict source-qualified consumer and avoids a new ~1.9GB cache write.
cache_decision.resource_note: Prediction arrays are existing read-only mmap inputs. Trainer preflight hashes both (~1.997GB total) before fit; this recipe did not read their payload or profile this distinct direct-teacher I/O path.

launch_template.resource_admission: Not included; root must profile/reconcile direct teacher-array read and issue the actual GPU fit admission. Do not launch from this document alone.

matched_training_recipe.architecture: plain GRU, hidden=256, layers=2, dropout=0, linear input encoder; 23 outputs.
matched_training_recipe.control_delta: Compared with R3 C: same architecture, parent init/preprocessing, split, fit membership, seed/order, optimizer/schedule, precision, exposure, checkpoint, propensity, loss, aux losses and output. Replace only T3 cache teacher source with one direct fixed parent prediction source at scale 1.0, keep alpha 0.9. The run name is unique. Stop-after-epoch from profile vector is removed because this is the complete two-epoch fit; four unsupported legacy argv pairs in the prepared R3 vector are also omitted without changing defaults.
matched_training_recipe.data_order: R3 C command and --batch-order seeded; base training row selection uses NumPy seed 3, then ConcatDataset(train-fit, valid-fit) is shuffled by EpochOrderSampler. Normalization pass epoch -1 uses seed 3; fit epochs 0/1 use torch.randperm seeds 1012/2021 respectively. The permutation crosses train/valid source boundary; drop_last retains 746 full B16 batches/epoch.
matched_training_recipe.initialization: --init c20261003_combo_s3_f0@ep3 plus --inherit-init-preprocessing; parent weights and mean/std start from exact checkpoint.
matched_training_recipe.loss: wmse, chunk normalization; aux_struct=0.3, aux_next=0.3; propensity c20260929_prop_f0 power=2 eps=0.03; no eval during fit.
matched_training_recipe.membership_and_budget: 10,535 train-fit + 1,405 valid-fit = 11,940 unique fitting sequences; 468 evaluation groups excluded. B16, chunk 2,000 gives 10 chunk updates/batch, 7,460 updates/epoch, 14,920 across 2 epochs.
matched_training_recipe.optimizer: fresh AdamW, lr=1e-4, wd=0.01, OneCycle; no optimizer state resumed from parent.
matched_training_recipe.precision: fp16 training; identical R3 C setting.

next_cheap_measurement.interpretation_limit: This is a fixed endpoint-complementarity check, not a fit/target causal test or public forecast. The frozen grader combines raw member arrays in float64 then casts to float32 and clips the final blend; training clips the teacher before blending with labels, so this output mixture is not bitwise the training target. It must not block S.
next_cheap_measurement.question: Does the fixed parent prediction plus the current scaled T3 teacher target have complementary signal on the already exposed 468-group F0 panel?
next_cheap_measurement.source_arrays: Existing full-valid parent and three clean-T3 epoch-2 prediction arrays; each T3 valid array is 1873x20000x2 float32 and sidecar pins exact run, epoch, checkpoint, split and prediction SHA. Metadata inspection only; no payload grade performed.

stage_alias_symlinks.purpose: The existing full-valid T3 exports use output-name suffix _local_full_valid_r1; score_fold0_panel looks up canonical pred_<run>_valid files. If and only if canonical targets are absent, create temporary symlinks from each bound T3 source array and its sidecar to its canonical lookup path, run the frozen grader, then remove only those symlinks. No array bytes are copied or altered. Do not overwrite existing paths.

runtime_binding_requirements: Recheck source worktree commit, complete R3 source-manifest SHA, and pinned trainer/module hashes before launch.
Recheck parent provenance SHA and exact model_ep3 checkpoint hash; assert fit and evaluation membership using source-qualified (train,group)/(valid,group) identities; confirm normalization hashes.
At launch, allow existing bind_fold_teachers to rehash both prediction arrays and verify sidecar names, split SHA and complete canonical row order against train_targets.npz and valid_targets.npz.

Inspect terminal provenance for exactly two epochs, fixed model_ep1.pt, 14,920 completed chunk updates, no AMP skips/nonfinite values, unchanged parent/source/membership hashes and one direct teacher at scale 1.0.

Export full-valid 1,873 predictions in FP32 feature-only mode; official grade only the frozen 468 evaluation groups against exact parent and R3 C endpoint. Report exposed F0/one seed; no public forecast.
scientific_claim_limit: Self-distillation/function anchoring from a parent that itself has earlier teacher ancestry; not teacher-free, not an independent teacher replication, not a teacher ceiling test, not a clean-holdout result.
scope: One matched two-epoch H256x2 child of the existing clean F0 seed-3 parent; no trainer source changes, cache build, fit, export or grade performed by this recipe author.

target_inputs.precision_limitation: Train sidecar declares fp16 inference; valid sidecar omits inference_precision. The exact prediction bytes are pinned, but valid-array inference precision is unknown from its metadata. Do not claim parent-vs-T3 precision parity or bitwise parent-forward parity.
target_inputs.producer: Existing parent direct-prediction artifacts; no new prediction export or distillation cache is produced by this recipe.
target_inputs.source_arithmetic: Existing direct --distill path; trainer checks sidecar run/split/split-manifest identity, canonical target row order and full prediction-file SHA before fit. Parent provenance/checkpoint/membership/normalization are separately pinned above.
target_inputs.target_scale_confound: Current clean-T3 cached target is float32(0.8125 * float32_mean(three epoch-2 clean T3 predictions)); S uses the raw parent output at scale 1.0. S-vs-C therefore changes teacher function/source and calibration scale together.
target_inputs.teacher_combination: one source: scale*prediction / number_of_teachers = parent prediction exactly in float32 storage arithmetic (scale=1, divisor=1).
target_inputs.weighting: Existing wmse weight: abs(clamp(label,-2,2)) * main_valid; aux-next and aux-struct remain unchanged.

trainer_source.launch_note: Invoke this frozen worktree trainer directly. Set PYTHONPATH to its src and WNN_PROJECT_ROOT to MAIN; do not let cleanfold_exec select MAIN/scripts/train_rnn.py.
